interpretation: Validation-only diagnostic, not a replacement acceptance set. Rank4 succeeds on about96% of random exact1-5-step queries but only about63-66% of the original complete long-query evaluation. Uniform shortage of near queries alone does not explain the remaining failures; actual policy occupancy and difficult local minima need separate checks. Short-walk training control is a hypothesis under test.
